pages.title: Sparrow Micro Studio
pages.text: Sparrow Micro Studio is a small brand and web design studio in Providence, Rhode Island. We work with startups and local shops on identity, websites and packaging.

pages.title: About Sparrow
pages.text: Founded in 2021 by two designers. Our team is 4 people, plus occasional freelance collaborators who work as independent contractors. We are remote-friendly and keep things small on purpose.

pages.title: Careers
pages.text: We are not hiring right now. If you are a freelance illustrator or developer, send us a portfolio and we will keep it on file.
